cases.title: Unmapped goal
cases.given: Owner creates supported goal; validated plan node_links=[]
cases.expected: 201 create; owner may read ready scene; no node mastery contribution

cases.title: Multiple nodes
cases.given: One course version maps pointers and linked list nodes
cases.expected: Both versioned links retained; neither overrides original goal

cases.title: Guest owner
cases.given: Valid existing guest session reads its course
cases.expected: 200; same owner as session, no account migration

cases.title: Semantic opinion
cases.given: Hard-valid scene with unconfirmed model reject
cases.expected: Owner can read draft; endorsement remains unendorsed

cases.title: Historical version
cases.given: Head=3, owner explicitly requests version=1
cases.expected: 200 exact version 1; no generation or head switch

cases.title: Partial course
cases.given: Manifest has first ready scene and second null
cases.expected: First readable; second 409 SCENE_NOT_READY; complete=false

cases.title: Idempotent create
cases.given: Same owner/key and canonical request repeated
cases.expected: Original 201 IDs; no duplicate course/operation/call

cases.title: Cross owner
cases.given: User B requests user A course, version or scene
cases.expected: 404 NOT_FOUND; no content, IDs or existence details

cases.title: No session
cases.given: Missing/expired cookie
cases.expected: 401 UNAUTHORIZED

cases.title: CSRF
cases.given: Authenticated POST with missing CSRF
cases.expected: 403 CSRF_FAILED; no writes or calls

cases.title: Forged privilege
cases.given: POST includes owner_id or endorsement=approved
cases.expected: 422 unknown fields; cannot assign owner or publish

cases.title: Foreign nested ID
cases.given: Own course with scene from another course
cases.expected: 404; composite FK rejects equivalent persistence attempt

cases.title: Old unpublished unit
cases.given: Old failed/review_required unit UUID used in new API
cases.expected: 404; no import or draft visibility promotion

cases.title: Missing history
cases.given: Request version 99 when head=3
cases.expected: 404; no latest fallback

cases.title: Withdrawn body
cases.given: Old manifest references scene later disabled by confirmed-defect fact
cases.expected: 409 CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE, no正文; current fact overrides historical readability

cases.title: Mixed dependencies
cases.given: Ready scene binds upstream version not in this manifest
cases.expected: Reject publication/head switch; no mixed visible snapshot

cases.title: Forged node
cases.given: Unknown node/version or duplicate link
cases.expected: Reject binding; unmatched valid goal may instead have []

cases.title: Idempotency conflict
cases.given: Same owner/key with changed goal
cases.expected: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; no new operation

cases.title: Catalog gate
cases.given: Valid new POST while catalog_only
cases.expected: 409 FREE_COURSE_DISABLED; no course/receipt/call

cases.title: Client answer leak
cases.given: Exercise storage includes solution and correct_answer
cases.expected: Public projection excludes both; never serialize raw content_json

cases.title: Empty goal
cases.given: Goal consists only of whitespace
cases.expected: 422; no writes/calls

cases.title: Unsafe content
cases.given: Scene invalid schema, executable HTML/JS or invalid action references
cases.expected: Not readable and cannot enter ready manifest

cases.title: Concurrent head
cases.given: Revision uses stale expected_head_version
cases.expected: 409; previous head and immutable versions preserved

cases.title: Destructive rollback
cases.given: Attempt downgrade with nonempty new course tables
cases.expected: Refuse before dropping tables; use forward recovery

cases.title: Unsigned sharing
cases.given: Another guest with copied course UUID or URL
cases.expected: 404; no device-based ownership inference
